XLM Price Prediction Explained: What to Expect by 2030 Stellar Lumens is a blockchain-based payment network that allows anyone to perform transactions with their native token XLM or any other asset on the Stellar blockchain. Stellar Lumens (XLM) is created for practical applications, to make payments faster, more affordable, and widely available on an international scale. The Stellar currency exchange works like traditional exchanges to let people swap between fiat and virtual currencies and transfer the assets anywhere in the world. Stellar, supported by the non-profit organization Stellar Development Foundation , not only represents the platform but also a highly efficient blockchain network. This consists of two main entities which are responsible for facilitating on-chain transactions and issuing credits. Stellar XLM Overview Stellar was launched on July 31, 2014, by Joyce Kim and Jeb McCaleb. The reason why XLM services resemble those of XRP is because Jeb McCaleb is one of the co-founders of Ripple. Jeb wanted Ripple to be a more transparent, decentralized, and peer-to-peer network. The disagreement with Ripple's core team led Jeb to join XLM, with his mission to offer a better payment solution for institutions and businesses in cross border transactions. Stellar follows a unique path with more focus on fast financial transactions and increased interoperability between traditional financial assets and cryptocurrencies. It is also focused on expanding cross border payments infrastructure and developing new partnerships and use cases. Stellar Price History and Market Position Due to the recent cryptocurrency market downtrend, XLM's market capitalization dropped from$14 billion to $10.32 billion, pulling down the price by over 15% within a day. Stellar had a total supply of 100 billion tokens. However, in 2019, the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) burned 50% of the supply, reducing the total XLM supply to 50 billion tokens. Out of the remaining 50 billion tokens, 30.21 XLM tokens are currently in circulating supply.
